China's chip exports are up to a record ~$290 billion over the last 12 months.

Western demand for China-made AI hardware is surging.

3. The power for the project is controlled by the US government and funded separately by Japan under a recent trade deal

4. Commerce Secretary Lutnick is reportedly involved in deciding who will get the power

The data center buildout just hit a whole new level.
